0|514c7dca85a0bf40be984dab0b477403a6db901f|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"btrfs: Check that each block group has corresponding chunk at mount time
A crafted btrfs image with incorrect chunk<->block group mapping will
trigger a lot of unexpected things as the mapping is essential.
Although the problem can be caught by block group item checker
added in ""btrfs: tree-checker: Verify block_group_item""
sufficient.  A sufficiently valid block group item can pass the check
added by the mentioned patch but could fail to match the existing chunk.
This patch will add extra block group -> chunk mapping check
we have a completely matching (start
group at mount time.
Here we reuse the original helper find_first_block_group()
already doing the basic bg -> chunk checks
start/len and type flags.
